full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated chords with light chorus and delay. Acoustic piano enters with sustained chords. Bass guitar plays melodic lines in the upper register before settling into root notes. Drums feature a crisp snare with heavy reverb and a soft kick. Male vocals are delivered in a breathy tenor, transitioning to a powerful chest voice in the higher register. Strings provide legato accompaniment. Key of E Major, 72 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
